entities.name: Avtyr
entities.description: A valkyrie shepherd of Starnheim, paired with Rytva.

entities.name: Rytva
entities.description: A valkyrie of Starnheim paired with Avtyr.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The realm of the valkyries on Kaldheim, never before visited by a mortal.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A visitor from Theros who warned the Valkyries about Koma. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The place of a tumultuous clash among warriors and of a later battle.

entities.name: Orhaft
entities.description: Whose magic guided Niko through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A path through which Niko journeyed to Starnheim.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A serpent that breached reality and attacked Kaldheim.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the valkyries and Koma's attack.

events.summary: Niko traps Avtyr with a magical shard during the clash at Bretagard.
events.quote: they managed to trap the Valkyrie using a magical shard

events.summary: Niko journeys through an Omenpath into Starnheim, guided by Orhaft's magic and trapped Avtyr.
events.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

events.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries about Koma; Avtyr accuses Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance, then Koma breaks through.
events.quote: especially Avtyr who accused Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance

events.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr use mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma back through the portals.
events.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

events.summary: Niko and Avtyr drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
events.quote: The climax saw Niko and Avtyr collaborating in a final, daring maneuver

events.summary: Avtyr brings Niko to the battle of Bretagard and joins it with other valkyries.
events.quote: Avtyr then brought Niko to the battle of Bretagard

relations.quote: Avtyr is a valkyrie shepherd of Starnheim , paired with Rytva .
